easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Blasting Station trigger, untapping all creatures and Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
Repeat.
